scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && tsc --noEmit && bun run build:sandpiper && bun run build:system-prompt && bun run build:standalone
scripts.build:sandpiper: rm -rf dist/sandpiper dist/chunks && mkdir -p dist && bun build --sourcemap --production --minify --target=bun --splitting --entry-naming sandpiper --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --external canvas --external css-tree --external jsdom --external better-sqlite3 --external '@earendil-works/*' --external '@mariozechner/*' ./sandpiper_standalone.ts --outdir ./dist && chmod +x ./dist/sandpiper
scripts.build:system-prompt: rm -f dist/sandpiper-system-prompt && mkdir -p dist && bun build --sourcemap --production --minify --target=bun --splitting --entry-naming sandpiper-system-prompt --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --external canvas --external css-tree --external jsdom --external better-sqlite3 --external '@earendil-works/*' --external '@mariozechner/*' ./sandpiper_system_prompt.ts --outdir ./dist && chmod +x ./dist/sandpiper-system-prompt
scripts.build:standalone: rm -rf dist/standalone && mkdir -p dist/standalone && bun build --sourcemap --production --minify --target=bun --splitting --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --external canvas --external css-tree --external jsdom --external better-sqlite3 --external '@earendil-works/*' --external '@mariozechner/*' ./sandpiper_standalone.ts ./sandpiper_system_prompt.ts --outdir ./dist/standalone
